sections.intent: Establish brand and conference identity at the top of the hub.
Provide a prominent registration prompt for the multi-session conference.
Summarize the conference scope, dates, and multi-track value.
Highlight headline speakers, tracks, or sponsors that make this edition compelling.
Show quotes from past attendees or organizers who ran similar multi-track events.
Close the homepage with practical next steps or a note on group registration.
Display a condensed grid or timeline of sessions, tracks, and breaks.
Introduce each speaker with a short bio and their session topic.
Explain accessibility, room setup, and nearby accommodation.
